name: Mihoto Yukihito
source:
[i]"So, what’s this about my mouth being bright blue? Isn't that just normal?"[/i]

Someone who's accompanying you during your stay in the village. He is a painter for a living, as his kimono is always splattered with paint. Perhaps due to his unusual upbringing, he's extremely sociable and easily gets physically close with others.

[Translated from [url=https://hyakunie.com/character/mihoto-yukihito/]official website[/url]]
